title: Concentration against time
back: Chord slope = average rate; tangent slope = instantaneous rate. Rate falls as the reactant is used up.

title: Energy profile with a catalyst
back: Catalyst: lower hill ($E_a′<E_a$). Reactants, products and ΔH unchanged.

title: Energy distribution at T and T + 10
back: At T + 10 the curve flattens and shifts right; the area beyond $E_a$ (molecules that can react) roughly doubles.

title: First-order plots
back: ln [R] against t: slope $-k$. log([R]₀/[R]) against t: through the origin, slope $k/2.303$.

title: Arrhenius plot
back: ln k against 1/T: straight line, slope $-E_a/R$, intercept ln A.

title: Rate law and order
back: Units of $k$: (mol L⁻¹)$^{1-n}$ s⁻¹. Never take $x,y$ from the balanced equation.

title: Zero-order reaction
back: Constant rate; [R] against t is a straight line of slope $-k$.

title: First-order reaction
legend: t = time for [R]_0 to fall to [R]
back: Half-life does not depend on $[R]_0$. 99.9% completion takes about 10 half-lives.

title: Arrhenius equation
back: From $k=Ae^{-E_a/RT}$. A 10 K rise roughly doubles $k$.

title: Rate from collision theory
back: Effective collision = enough energy + proper orientation.

title: Order vs molecularity
back: Order: from the rate law, can be 0 or fractional. Molecularity: species in one elementary step, only 1, 2 or 3.

title: The road, not the destination
back: A catalyst lowers $E_a$ by a new path; it does not change ΔH, ΔG or K.
